description: This Java interface defines a builder for creating responses and events related to the 'ModifyFeatures' command within a live signals command framework for the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies factory interfaces for generating command responses (such as creation, modification, and error responses) and events (such as features created or modified).

classes.name: ModifyFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface for building command responses and events related to the ModifyFeatures command in a live signal processing context.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating command response objects such as created, modified, or error responses for the ModifyFeatures command.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating event objects triggered by the ModifyFeatures command, such as features created or modified events.
